Technical Documentation

CSV Check 1.0.0 User Guide

CSV Check is a teaching tool for inspecting CSV tables. It reads only the header and row structure and never modifies your data. Use it to verify that a submitted CSV contains the required columns.

Tool version 1.0.0 Python 3.7+ Windows / macOS / Linux Standard library only

1. Prerequisites

ItemRequirementNotes
Python3.7 or later (tested on 3.12.10)Standard library only; no pip install needed
Operating systemWindows / macOS / LinuxCommand names differ slightly (see below)
Tool filescheck.py, the csvcheck/ package, and the .csv file to checkcheck.py must sit next to csvcheck/
Input encodingUTF-8 (BOM optional)Other encodings are rejected

Verify that Python is available

PowerShellshell
python --version

Expected output:

OutputOK
Python 3.12.10
Command name Windows usually uses python or py; macOS/Linux usually uses python3. If python --version prints no version and simply opens the Microsoft Store, the system only has a placeholder executable — install a real Python first.

Directory layout

02_文档网站/ ├─ check.py # command-line entry point ├─ csvcheck/ # local package (__init__.py, __main__.py) └─ samples/ ├─ students.csv # valid sample ├─ missing-name.csv # missing-column sample ├─ empty.csv # empty-file sample └─ students.tsv

2. Step-by-step

Step 1 — Open the folder (change into the working directory)

You must run the tool from the directory that contains check.py; otherwise it cannot import the sibling csvcheck package.

PowerShellshell
cd "C:\Users\孟昱含\Desktop\A研究生\1aa 课程-研一上\数智赋能课\10.28技术文档写作\学生实践包\02_文档网站"

Alternatively, open the folder in File Explorer, type powershell in the address bar, and press Enter to launch a terminal in that directory.

Step 2 — Run check.py from that directory

PowerShellshell
python check.py <path-to-csv>

The path may be relative or absolute. Quote it if it contains spaces.

PowerShellshell
# Relative path (shorter)
python check.py samples/students.csv

# Absolute path
python check.py "C:\Users\孟昱含\Desktop\A研究生\1aa 课程-研一上\数智赋能课\10.28技术文档写作\学生实践包\01_写作练习\samples\missing-name.csv"

Use --require to override the required columns; the default set is id, name, score:

PowerShellshell
python check.py samples/students.csv --require id score

Step 3 — Read the output (rows and columns)

Actual output for the valid sample samples/students.csv:

students.csvPASS · exit code 0
CSV Check 1.0.0
File: samples/students.csv
Data rows: 3
Columns: id, name, score
Missing columns: none
Result: PASS
PASS checks column names, not score values.

Output fields

LineMeaning
CSV Check 1.0.0Tool version
File:Path of the inspected file
Data rows:Number of data rows, excluding the header and blank lines
Columns:Column names read from the header, in original order
Missing columns:Required columns that are absent; none when all are present
Result:PASS if all required columns exist, FAIL otherwise
Last lineReminder: PASS validates column names only, not cell values such as scores

Exit codes

CodeMeaningTypical case
0Check passedAll required columns present
1Check failedOne or more required columns missing
2File could not be readEmpty file, non-UTF-8 content, inconsistent field count

3. Troubleshooting

SymptomCauseFix
'python' is not recognized (exit code 9009) Python is not installed or not on PATH Install Python and enable "Add Python to PATH", or call the full path C:\Users\...\Python312\python.exe
Running python opens Microsoft Store with no version output WindowsApps\python.exe is a store placeholder, not a real interpreter Install a real Python, then confirm with python --version
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'csvcheck' Not running from the check.py directory, or check.py was copied away alone cd into 02_文档网站; keep csvcheck/ beside check.py
ERROR: File has no header. The file is empty, or the first row is not a header Ensure the file starts with a header such as id,name,score
Result: FAIL with Missing columns: name A required column is missing Add the missing column; names are case-sensitive and must not be blank
Header names must not be blank. The header contains an empty name (e.g. id,,score) Remove the extra comma
Header names must be unique. Duplicate column names in the header Rename the duplicates
Row N has X fields; expected Y. A data row has a different field count than the header Check every row for extra or missing commas
Cannot read a UTF-8 CSV file: ... File is not UTF-8, or it is locked / inaccessible Re-save as UTF-8; close programs that hold the file
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'check' A different file with the same name was executed Pass the full script path: python "full\path\check.py" file.csv
running scripts is disabled / UnauthorizedAccess at the end PowerShell execution policy blocks the profile script; unrelated to the tool Tool output is still valid; to silence it, run Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope CurrentUser RemoteSigned
File not found when the path contains spaces Path is not quoted Wrap the whole path in double quotes

Suggested check order

  1. Does python --version print a version?
  2. Are check.py and csvcheck/ both visible in the current directory?
  3. Is the target file non-empty, UTF-8, and properly headed?
  4. Use the exit code to distinguish "check failed (1)" from "file unreadable (2)".

4. Notes

Keep in mind The tool performs a structural check only; PASS does not guarantee that scores or other values are correct.
  • It never modifies the input file, so it can be run repeatedly.
  • Header matching is exact: column names are case-sensitive, with no fuzzy matching or aliases.
  • To check many files, pass each path in turn or write a small loop that calls inspect_csv.
Based on the tool and sample files shipped in 学生实践包/02_文档网站. All sample outputs and screenshots come from actual runs.
